body: Owner, 2026-10-03. The library creates no FOREIGN KEY and no ON DELETE CASCADE on any engine, in the core or any plugin. Every table holding a user's rows declares its user column to the core, and Auth.DeleteUser removes those rows itself, in Go, in one transaction; plugins delete their own child rows (for example organization members) the same way. Why: sharding and moving tables stay easy, the deletion rules live in Go where tests cover them, and every session store (SQL, Redis, memory, custom) behaves alike. A guard test fails when a registered user-owned table is not cleaned. See the private notes
title: No foreign keys and no database cascades: tables are plain storage, the library deletes related rows in Go
